title: ZIP code 36619 in Alabama had 3,615 Social Security beneficiaries in December 2024
text:
ZIP code 36619 in Alabama had 3,615 Social Security beneficiaries in December 2024
J. A. Mercer
ZIP Code 36619 in Alabama had a reported total of 3,615 Social Security beneficiaries in December 2024. That is 10 fewer than the December 2023 reporting period, a reported change of -0.3%. All ZIP-level figures are approximate because the SSA applies controlled rounding under its publication standards.
The Old-Age, Survivors, and Disability Insurance program, commonly called Social Security, pays monthly benefits to qualified retired and disabled workers, their dependents and survivors of insured workers. Eligibility and benefit amounts are determined by a worker's Social Security-covered earnings and contributions rather than financial need. OASDI is distinct from Supplemental Security Income, or SSI, which provides benefits based primarily on limited income and resources and is funded through general federal tax revenues rather than employment taxes.
In 2024 retired workers were the largest group in ZIP Code 36619, with a reported 2,610 beneficiaries, representing approximately 72.2% of the total. Disabled workers were second with 430 beneficiaries, about 11.9%. Other groups included widow(er)s and parents (260, 7.2%), children (210, 5.8%), and spouses (105, 2.9%). Retired workers remain the largest category and disabled workers the second largest. Additionally, 2,805 beneficiaries were aged 65 or older, representing around 77.6% of all reported groups combined; this age measure spans all five categories and is not an additional separate category.
Over the past year retired workers in ZIP Code 36619 increased by 45, while disabled workers decreased by 40. Widow(er)s and parents, spouses, and children each declined by five beneficiaries. These changes reflect category-level figures that are rounded independently. In this year the reported category counts add exactly to the reported total, though independent rounding can sometimes produce apparent summation errors.
In December 2024 Social Security beneficiaries in ZIP Code 36619 received a reported $6.61 million in monthly benefits. The average monthly benefit per beneficiary was about $1,829. Because values are source-rounded, the reported totals and averages do not precisely reflect underlying dollar amounts.
Published December readings for ZIP Code 36619, Alabama, cover 2018 through 2024, seven observations in all. The 2024 figure is near the higher end of the published annual totals for the ZIP, which have fluctuated but generally remained between 3,525 and 3,625 over this period. These are reported and published observations; years with low counts are omitted from publication, so not every year a ZIP exists is necessarily included.
| Beneficiary category | 2024 beneficiaries | 2023 beneficiaries | Change | 2024 share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Retired workers | 2,610 | 2,565 | +45 | 72.2% |
| Disabled workers | 430 | 470 | -40 | 11.9% |
| Widow(er)s and parents | 260 | 265 | -5 | 7.2% |
| Spouses | 105 | 110 | -5 | 2.9% |
| Children | 210 | 215 | -5 | 5.8% |
| Year | Reported beneficiaries | Annual change |
|---|---|---|
| 2018 | 3,605 | n/a |
| 2019 | 3,600 | -5 |
| 2020 | 3,540 | -60 |
| 2021 | 3,525 | -15 |
| 2022 | 3,555 | +30 |
| 2023 | 3,625 | +70 |
| 2024 | 3,615 | -10 |
Beneficiary and benefit figures are drawn from OASDI Beneficiaries by State and ZIP Code, 2024, and state population data are from the U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey. Counts are for beneficiaries in current-payment status in December and assign ZIP Code using SSA address records, which may reflect a representative payee’s address. ZIP-level counts are controlled-rounded, generally to the nearest five; categories are rounded independently and may not sum exactly to the published total. ZIP rows below the SSA publication threshold are omitted, so a missing row means unavailable rather than zero, and trends include only published years. National, state-total and field-office rows are excluded as ZIP story subjects; statewide context uses the published state-total record rather than summed ZIP rows. The 51-jurisdiction comparison is a pooled beneficiary-to-population ratio, not a national rate or an unweighted mean of jurisdiction rates.

In 2024 retired workers were the largest group in ZIP Code 36619, with a reported 2,610 beneficiaries, representing approximately 72.2% of the total. In December 2024 Social Security beneficiaries in ZIP Code 36619 received a reported $6.61 million in monthly benefits. The 2024 figure is near the higher end of the published annual totals for the ZIP, which have fluctuated but generally remained between 3,525 and 3,625 over this period.
